_why: HAND-COMPUTED. The root is a 400x200 column at padding 12 with alignItems:center,
so it centres the row HORIZONTALLY. The row is swatch(96) + gap(12) + button(128)
+ gap(12) + readout(110 fixed) = 358 wide; inner width 376, so the row left edge is
12 + (376-358)/2 = 21. Row height = tallest child = 44, placed at the top padding 12.
The settled scene is the FIXED-width slot carrying the longest label 'light · running'
(15 monospace chars ~ 99px < 110px, so it must not clip). (5,5) is the white root
outside the row; (60,30) is the swatch interior; (180,30) is the button interior.
The behavioural assertions (text-sized readout MOVES the button; fixed-width slot
keeps it put across every label) are in the program -- they are about layout deltas
across re-describes, which a single static frame cannot show.
